create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with id2word, word2id mappings and a language code
check_valid_dictionary: check that a Dictionary's id2word and word2id mappings are consistent and valid
prune_dictionary: prune a Dictionary to limit the vocabulary size to a maximum number of words
get_word_index: get the index of a specified word in the Dictionary using the index method
compare_dictionaries: compare two Dictionary instances for equality by checking language and word mappings
